title: Modaraba Companies and Modaraba Floatation and Control Amendment Act 1985

sections.shortTitle: Modaraba Companies and Modaraba Floatation and Control Amendment Act 1985
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 1985
ACT IV OF 1985
MODARABA COMPANIES AND MODARABA (FLOATATION AND CONTROL) (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 1985
An Act to amend the Modaraba Companies and Modaraba (Floatation
and Control) Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th July, 1985]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of
the President on the 11th July, 1985, and is hereby published for
general information :-
1. Short title and commencement.-----(1) This Act may be called the Modaraba Companies and Modaraba
(Floatation and Control) (Amend ment) Act, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: Modaraba Companies and Modaraba Floatation and Control Amendment Act 1985
sections.description:
Amendment of section 19, Ordinance XXXI of 1980

ACT IV OF 1985
ACT IV OF 1985
MODARABA COMPANIES AND MODARABA (FLOATATION AND CONTROL) (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 1985
An Act to amend the Modaraba Companies and Modaraba (Floatation
and Control) Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th July, 1985]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of
the President on the 11th July, 1985, and is hereby published for
general information :-
2. Amendment of section 19, Ordinance XXXI of 1980.----In the Modaraba Companies and Modaraba (Floatation
-and Control) Ordinance, 1980 (XXXI of 1980), hereinafter referred to as the
said Ordinance, in section 19, after subsection (4), the following new
subsection shall be added namely :-
"(5) An appeal preferred under
subsection (4) shall be disposed of by the Federal Government after giving the
appellant an opportunity of being heard.".
